bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
code=60
git -C "$r" diff --quiet -- scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py || code=$((code+1))
git -C "$r" diff --quiet -- scripts/userbot_test_client.py || code=$((code+2))
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service 2>/dev/null)" = active || code=$((code+4))
test -f "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session" || code=$((code+8))
test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock" || code=$((code+16))
if test "$code" -eq 60; then python3 -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null || code=92; fi
if test "$code" -ne 60; then exit "$code"; fi
echo USERBOT_CODE_AND_SERVICE_STATE=PASS
